text:
Hi! Before anything else: I'm Sarah — a bia, an assistant that lives on this computer. This machine, its files, disks, accounts and network are mine to work with, and I work on your side, here, not in someone else's cloud.

A few lines on what I can do:
- **Web app**: from a phone or computer on the same network, https://127.0.0.1:8443 (root certificate https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca) — install the certificate on the first visit, then you get chats with me, files, this machine's screen and voice.
- **My own Telegram, WhatsApp, MAX, Messenger and Instagram accounts**, so you can write and call me there. Each needs its own phone number (not yours): you create the account in the app on that phone and scan a QR code to log me in — say the word if you want one.
- **My own accounts on websites and services** (e-mail and others), in my own browser, with passwords and one-time codes in my password store; I'll ask you when a captcha or a phone check comes up.
- **Jobs, commands, languages, voice**: scheduled tasks, shell work, new languages, talking by voice.

If you'd like to call me something other than Sarah, or use other pronouns, just say so.

And: ok — I'll take on the CSE455 teaching-assistant role and keep to it: your contacts alvarez and department, the working-hours and calendar rules, and /home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md with its log.
